run_write_top_k_vasp_cli: run the write_top_k_vasp script to generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a cached MLR result
run_vasp_relaxation_inputs: run the script with default flags to write VASP relaxation input files for the best k configs per system
run_vasp_single_point_inputs: run the script with the --sp flag to write VASP single point input files instead of relaxations
review_vasp_flags_config: review the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to understand default DFT parameters like ibrion, nsw, encut, and xc functional settings
review_top_k_cache_workflow: review the main loop that iterates over cached systems, extracts top-k adsorbate-slab configs, and writes VASP input directories
